text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sarajevo press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Sarajevo will host a conference of Islamic Countries on June 27-28 which is expected to urge stronger political action on the implementation of the Dayton peace treaty.
- Bosnia and Croatia have been promised credits for resonstruction of transport links which pass through European countries, officials attending conference of transport ministers in Helsinki say.
- The collective presidency will discuss the issue of distributing diplomatic posts at its session on Friday. The Serbs are requesting more than one third of the posts, sources tell newspaper.
- The film companu "Fama" has started shooting a documentary about the siege of Sarajevo.

- Bosnia's two entities have yet to agree on a design for a single currency, which is a condition for holding the international donors' conference, says Hasan Muratovic, foreign trade minister. The conference may be postoned indefinitely as a result.

- "I was proud for being criticised by all three parties for being biased, and I hope you will realise that I was only biased when the implementation of what had been agreed was at stake," outgoing deputy to the international High Representative to Bosnia, Michael Steiner, says. -- Sarajevo newsroom +387-71-663-864
